Nina (PM): Quick sync: we need a rollout recipe for 'regional-steering' next sprint. Must include staged regions, per-tenant opt-ins for enterprise, A/B quality guard, and an explicit fallback. Who takes which gates?

Jon (Eng): I can own feature-flag rollout and automation. Proposed ramps: 0.25% smoke -> 3% small -> 20% medium -> 70% large -> 100%. Default bakes: 30m, 1h, 3h, 6h. Manual approval required between 70%->100%.

Ravi (SRE): Add a 10m warmup on each regional step to let caches/KV populate. Pre-scale for any regional step >=20%. Circuit breaker: if triggered, shift to route-legacy with 95/5 split for 5m then evaluate.

Elsa (Product Ops): Gating rules (block step if):
- p95 latency up > 18% vs baseline
- error rate > 1.4x OR absolute errors > 1.5%
- A/B quality drop > 1.2% (Ivy sets metric)
Also: each step needs a named owner and contact list; publish runbook and audit approvals.

Tomas (CS): BigCorp needs opt-in and a per-tenant holdback flag. We need an in-app banner and email before their ramp; plus one-click holdback on CS dashboard.

Ivy (Data): For A/B quality: run live evals + seeded prompt set. Track exact-match, semantic-similarity, hallucination-rate. Gate if 2/3 metrics breach thresholds across two consecutive 20m windows. Ill supply baselines and dashboards.

Jon (Eng): Example flag payload to flags-service:
```json
{"flag":"regional-steering","variants":["control","steering_v1"],"steps":[{"pct":0.25,"regions":["us-west"]},{"pct":3,"regions":["us-west","eu-central"]},{"pct":20,"regions":["*"]},{"pct":70,"regions":["*"]},{"pct":100,"regions":["*"]}],"per_tenant_holdback":true,"kill_switch":"flags.disable.regional-steering"}
```
Use tenant-hash for bucket seeding so tenants arent split.

Ravi (SRE): Fallback escalation: on circuit trip -> immediate split 95% legacy / 5% variant for signal; if errors continue > 10m, auto-rollback and page #eng-oncall. Also log rollout audit events to compliance stream.

Nina (PM): Owners/tasks: Jon (flags + scripts), Ivy (evals + alerts), Ravi (capacity + circuit), Elsa (playbook + approval flow), Tomas (customer comms + opt-ins). Dry-run Friday at 0.25% in staging?

Jon (Eng): Dry-run Friday OK. Will push staging flag and run loadgen. Will paste quick pass/fail in this thread.

deploy-bot: flagged push to staging scheduled for 2026-04-03T16:00Z (regional-steering staging). :rocket:

Elsa (Product Ops): Ill draft the playbook and the kill-switch quick steps; will share link. Reminder: record approvals in audit log and capture the approver IDs.
